targets.statement: Groups at special risk for fatigue-related crashes include sixteen- to twenty-four-year-olds who often need extra sleep, people with untreated obstructive sleep apnea facing seven times the risk of falling asleep at the wheel, night-shift workers facing nearly six times the risk, and rotating-shift or over-sixty-hour-a-week workers who must be especially careful.
